verses.t: Kalata iyi yachokera kwa Paulo, mtumwi wa Khristu Yesu, wokhazikitsidwa mwa lamulo la Mulungu Mpulumutsi wathu ndi Khristu Yesu, chiyembekezo chathu.
Ndikulemba kwa Timoteo, mwana wanga weniweni m'chikhulupiriro. Chisomo, chifundo, ndi mtendere zichokere kwa Mulungu Atate ndi Khristu Yesu Ambuye wathu.
Ndinalomba ukhale ku Efeso pomwe ndinachoka kupita ku Makedoniya, kuti ualangize ena asiye maphunziro achilendo.
Musawalole asiye nthawi yawo pa nthano zopanda phindu ndi mzera wa makolo, zimene zimabweretsa mikangano yokha, osati ntchito ya Mulungu mwa chikhulupiriro.
Cholinga cha malangizo anga ndi chikondi chochokera ku mtima woyera, chikumbu mtima chowona, ndi chikhulupiriro chenicheni.
Koma ena apatuka ku izi, natembenukira ku ziyankhulo zopanda phindu.
Akufuna kudziwika ngati aphunzitsi a malamulo, koma sadziwa zimene akunena, ngakhale ayankhula mwatsimikizo.
Tidziwa kuti malamulo ndi abwino ngati agwiritsidwa ntchito mwabwino.
Tidziwa kuti malamulo sanachitikira anthu olungama. Anachitikira ochita zoyipa ndi osamvera, opanda Mulungu ndi ochimwa, opanda uyeru ndi opanda ulemu, opha makolo kapena opha anthu ena,
achitchirerwa chiwerewere, amachita zoyipa pakati pa amuna okha, agulitsa akapolo, anama, olumbira monyenga, ndi onse ochita china chilichonse chotsutsa maphunziro abwino
achokera ku Uthenga Wabwino wa ulemerero wa Mulungu wadalitsika, amene anandikhazikitsa.
Ndiyamika Khristu Yesu Ambuye wathu amene wandipatsa mphamvu, chifukwa anaona kuti ndine wokhulupirika, nandikhazikitsa kutumikira iye,
ngakhale kale ndinali wonyoza dzina lake, ndinazunza anthu ake, ndi kuwachitira nkhanza. Koma Mulungu anandichitira chifundo chifukwa ndinachita izi m'kusadziwa, ndisanakhulupirire.
Ndipo chisomo cha Ambuye wathu chinadzaza kwambiri pamodzi ndi chikhulupiriro ndi chikondi mwa Khristu Yesu.
Ichi ndi mawu okhulupirika, oyenerera kulandidwa ndi aliyense: Khristu Yesu anabwera m'dziko lapansi kupulumutsa ochimwa, ndipo ine ndine wochimwa koposa onse.

Koma Mulungu anandichitira chifundo kuti Khristu Yesu aonetse m'ine, wochimwa koposa onse, kupirira kwake kwathunthu, kuti akhale chitsanzo kwa iwo onse amene adzakhulupirira mwa iye nalandira moyo wosatha.
Ulemerero ndi ulemu ukhale kwa Mfumu yosatha, yosaoneka, yosafa, Mulungu mmodzi, nthawi yonse ndi nthawi yonse! Ameni.
Timoteo, mwana wanga, ndipereka malangizo amenewa kwa iwe malinga ndi zimene aneneri analankhula za iwe kale, kuti akuthandize kulimbana bwino nkhondo.
Mangirira chikhulupiriro chako ndi chikumbu mtima chowona. Ena anakana chikumbu mtima chao, nasokoneza chikhulupiriro chawo.
Himeneyo ndi Alekisande ndi amenewo. Ndinawataya, nawapereka kwa Satana kuti aphunzire kusamanyoza Mulungu.
Choyamba chake, ndikukukomba kuti mapemphero, malonjezo, zikhano ndi chiyamiko zichitike chifukwa cha anthu onse.
Pemphererani mafumu ndi onse ali pa ulamuliro, kuti tikhale ndi moyo wabata ndi wamtendere, m'uyeru ndi ulemu.
Ichi ndi chabwino ndipo chimakondweretsa Mulungu Mpulumutsi wathu,
amene akufuna anthu onse apulumutsidwe ndi kumvetsa choonadi.
Pakuti Mulungu ndi mmodzi, ndipo wogawana pakati pa Mulungu ndi anthu ndi mmodzi, munthu Khristu Yesu,
amene anadzipereka ngati mtengo wolombola onse. Uthenga umenewu unaperekeka nthawi yake.
Chifukwa cha ichi, ine ndinasankhidwa kukhala mlalikiri ndi mtumwi, ndikuphunzitsa aAmuni za chikhulupiriro ndi choonadi. Sindinama, ndikunena zoona.
Choncho ndifuna amuna apemphere m'malo onse opemphera, akweze manja oyera opanda mkwiyo ndi mikangano.
Mwanjira yomweyo, ndifuna akazi avale zovala zoyenera, mozichepetsa ndi mwanzeru, osati ndi ngeli kapena zokongola za golidi kapena mapewa kapena zovala zipereka.
M'malo mwake, akazi amene akuti ndi odzipereka kwa Mulungu azizionetse mwa ntchito zabwino.
Akazi aphunzire mwa bata ndi kumvera.
Sindilolereza mkazi kuphunzitsa amuna kapena kuwalamulira. Akhale chete.
Pakuti Adamu analengedwa woyamba, kenaka Hava.
Ndipo si Adamu amene anapusitsidwa ndi Satana. Mkazi ndiye amene anapusitsidwa, nachimwa.
Koma akazi adzapulumutsidwa mwa kubereka ana, ngati akhalabe m'chikhulupiriro, chikondi, uyeru, ndi chodzichepetsa.
Ichi ndi mawu okhulupirika: Ngati wina akhumba udindo wa mtsogoleri wa mpingo, akhumba ntchito yabwino.
Choncho mtsogoleri wa mpingo ayenera kukhala wopanda cholakwa, mkazi mmodzi, wodziretsa, wanzeru, woyenerera, wokonda alendo, wotha kuphunzitsa.
Asakhale woledzera kapena waukali, koma ofatsa, wosakankhana, wosada ndalama.
Ayenera kusamalira bwino nyumba yake, ana ake akhale olapa ndi ogonjera mwaulemu.
Pakuti ngati wina sathe kusamalira nyumba yake, adzasamalira bwino bwanji mpingo wa Mulungu?
Mtsogoleri ayenera kukhala osati wokhulupirira watsopano, kuti asadzikuze nadzigwa m'chiweruzo cha Satana.
Ndipo ayenera kulemekeredwa ndi anthu kunja kwa mpingo, kuti asagwe m'msampha wa Satana ndi manyazi.
Mwanjira yomweyo, adikoni ayenera kukhala olemekera, osati oyankhula ndi mutu wawiri, osaledzera, osada ndalama.
Ayenera kusungira chinsinsi cha chikhulupiriro ndi chikumbu mtima chowona.
Ayezedwe koyamba, kenaka asanaike udindo. Ngati apalira mayeso, akhale adikoni.
Mwanjira yomweyo, akazi awo ayenera kukhala olemekera, osanama za anthu. Akhale odziretsa ndi okhulupirika m'chilichonse.
Adikoni akhale ndi mkazi mmodzi, nasamalire bwino ana ndi nyumba yawo.
Amene agwira ntchito yabwino ngati adikoni adzalemekeredwa ndi anthu ndi kukhala otsimikizika pa chikhulupiriro mwa Khristu Yesu.
Ndikulemba izi ndikuyembekezera kubwera kwa iwe posachedwa,
koma ngati ndikachedwa, udziwe mmene anthu ayenera kukhala m'nyumba ya Mulungu. Iyi ndi mpingo wa Mulungu wamoyo, chipilala ndi maziko a choonadi.

Ndithudi, chinsinsi cha uyeru ndi chachikulu: Khristu anaulukira m'thupi la anthu, naonekeratu wolungama ndi Mzimu. Anaonedwa ndi angelo, nalalikidwa kwa aAmuni. Anakhulupiriridwa m'dziko lonse, natengeka kumwamba m'ulemerero.
Tsopano Mzimu Woyera akunena mwachindunji kuti m'nthawi zotsirira, ena atembenuka kuchoka ku chikhulupiriro chenicheni, natsata mizimu yochipusitsa ndi maphunziro a ziwanda.
Anthu amenewa ndi achinyengo ndi anama, omwe chikumbu mtima chao chowotcheka ngati ndi chopakidwa ndi chitsulo chochitsya.
Adzaletsa ukwati ndi kudya chakudya china chilichonse. Koma Mulungu analenga chakudya kuti chadyedwe ndi kuyamika ndi okhulupirira amene amudziwa choonadi.
Chilichonse chimene Mulungu anachilenga ndi chabwino, ndipo chilichonse ndi chopanda cholakwa ngati chiyamikidwa ndi mapemphero.
Pakuti chiyeretsedwa mwa Mawu a Mulungu ndi mapemphero.
Ngati uuza abale izi, udzakhala mtumiki wabwino wa Khristu Yesu, wodziwa mauthenga a chikhulupiriro ndi maphunziro abwino amene wakutsata.
Siya nthano zonyansa ndi za amayi akulu. M'malo mwake, uziphunzitsa nokha kukhala wopembedza Mulungu.
Kophunzitsa thupi kulipo phindu pang'ono, koma kupembedza Mulungu kulipo phindu pa chilichonse, pakuti chili ndi lonjezo la moyo wa tsopano ndi wa mtsogolo.
Mauthenga amenewo ndi okhulupirika ndipo oyenerera kulandidwa ndi aliyense.
Ndiko chifukwa tikugwira ntchito molemetsa ndi kulimbana, chifukwa taika chiyembekezo chathu mwa Mulungu wamoyo, amene ndi Mpulumutsi wa anthu onse, makamaka okhulupirira.
Phunzitsa izi ndi kukakamiza aliyense kuzitsata.
Musalole wina akukuzengerera chifukwa cha umwana wako. M'malo mwake, khala chitsanzo kwa okhulupirira pa mau ako, khalidwe, chikondi, chikhulupiriro, ndi uyeru.
Mpaka ndibwere, yang'anira kuwerenga Malemba pamaso pa mpingo, kulimbikitsa, ndi kuphunzitsa.
Usasiye mphatso yako yapadera imene unalandira mwa uprofeta aneneri atanaike manja pa iwe ankulu a mpingo.
Dzipereka ku izi. Uzipereke nazo ndi mtima wako wonse kuti aliyense aone kupita kwako kutsogolo.
Samala pa moyo wako ndi maphunziro ako. Khala molimba pa izi, chifukwa ukachita ichi udzapulumutsa iwe nokha ndi amene akumvera.
Usamawukire mwamuna wachikulire. M'malo mwake, mkomberani ulemu ngati bambo ako. Lalikira amuna achichepere ngati abale.
Lalikira akazi achikulire ngati amayi, ndipo lalikira achichepere ndi uyeru wonse ngati alongo.
Lemekeza amasiye weniweni, amene alibe amene angawasamalire.
Koma ngati masiye ali ndi ana kapena zidzukulu, ana amenewa ayenera kuphunzira choyamba kuonetsera uyeru kunyumba yawo ndi kubwezera zabwino kwa makolo awo. Ichi chimakondweretsa Mulungu.
Masiye weniweni, wokhala yekha, waika chiyembekezo mwa Mulungu. Akapemphera usiku ndi usana, nalomba Mulungu thandizo.
Koma masiye amene akhala mwa zosangalatsa okha ndi akufa ngakhale ali ndi moyo.
Upereke malangizo amenewo kuti amasiye asakhale ndi cholakwa.
Koma amene sasamalira abale ake, makamaka a nyumba yake, wakanira chikhulupiriro ndipo ndi woipa kuposa mopanda chikhulupiriro.
Masiye woyenera kuikidwa pa mndandanda ayenera kukhala ndi zaka makumi asanu ndi limodzi, nali mkazi wa mwamuna mmodzi.
Ayenera kudziwika ndi ntchito yake yabwino: anayang'anira ana awo bwino, anapokera alendo, anasamba mapazi a anthu oyera, anathandiza osautsika, ndipo anadzikumiritsa pa ntchito yabwino iliyonse.
Amasiye achichepere usawaike pa mndandanda, pakuti chisiriro chidzawaletsa kuchita ntchito ya Khristu, nafuna kukwatirwa.
Motero adzakhala ndi mlandu wa kusiya lonjezo lawo loyamba.
Ndiponso adzaphunzira kukhala achipere, anyengu kunyumba ndi kunyumba, ndipo osati okha kulephera koma oyankhula zinthu zosafunikira ndi kusamalira za ena.
Choncho ndikufuna amasiye achichepere akwatirwe, abereke ana, nasamalire nyumba zawo. Motero mdani sadzapeza mawu oyipa wonenera.
Pakuti ena mwa iwo atapatuka kale, natsata Satana.
Ngati mkazi wokhulupirira ali ndi masiye m'banja lake, ayenera kuwasamalira osataya udindo umenewu pa mpingo. Motero mpingo utha kusamalira amasiye amene alibe amene angawasamalire.
Akulu a mpingo amene agwira ntchito yao yabwino ayenera kulemekeredwa ndi kulipidwa bwino, makamaka iwo amene agwira ntchito ya ulalikiri ndi kuphunzitsa.
Pakuti Malemba akuti, 'Usafunge kamwa ng'ombe ikuphwanya tirigu,' ndipo, 'Wogwira ntchito ayenera kulipidwa.'
Usamvere mulandu pa mkulu wa mpingo kupatula ngati mboni ziwiri kapena zitatu zamuuza.
Iwo amene achimwa awadzudzule pamaso pa aliyense kuti ena alerere.
Ndikuuza molimba pamaso pa Mulungu ndi Khristu Yesu ndi angelo osankhidwa kuti usunge malamulo amenewo osatengera mbali kapena kupatsa wina patsogolo.
Usaike manja pa wina mofulumira. Usagawane machimo a ena. Udzisunga nokha woyera.
Usanwe madzi okha. Mamwa nalinso vinyo pang'ono pa mimba yako chifukwa umadwala kawirikawiri.
Machimo a ena amaonekera poyera, apitirira ku chiweruzo. Koma a ena adzaonekera pambuyo.
Mwanjira yomweyo, ntchito zabwino zimawonekeratu, ndipo ngakhale zobisika sizidzakhala zobisika nthawi yonse.
Onse amene ali akapolo aonetse abwana awo ulemu wathunthu kuti dzina la Mulungu ndi maphunziro ake asanyozedwe.

Akapolo amene abwana awo ndi okhulupirira asawaone bwino chifukwa ndi abale. M'malo mwake, agwire ntchito molemetsa koposa, chifukwa ntchito yawo ikuthandiza okhulupirira amene amawakonda. Phunzitsa ndi kukakamiza izi.
Ngati wina alalikira zochilira ndi kutsutsa maphunziro abwino a Ambuye Yesu Khristu ndi maphunziro oyenerera Mulungu,
iye ndi wodzikuza ndi wopanda nzeru. Akhumba mikangano ndi miyandamiyanda ya mawu, zimene zimabweretsa nsanje, mikangano, manyazitso, ndi kuganizira zoyipa.
Izi ndi zopangana za anthu amene maganizo awo yonongeka ndi achoka ku choonadi. Amaona uyeru ngati njira yopeza chuma.
Koma kupembedza Mulungu mwa kukhutirika ndi chuma chachikulu kwenikweni.
Pakuti sitinaletse kanthu tibwera m'dziko, ndipo sitidzatenge kanthu tichoka.
Choncho ngati tili ndi chakudya ndi zovala, tizikhutirike nazo.
Koma amene akhumba kukhala achuma agwa m'mayesero ndi kumangidwa m'zofuna zopusa ndi zoyipa zimene zimawataya ku chiwonongeko ndi chisomeko.
Pakuti kukonda ndalama ndi mzizi wa zoipa zonse. Ena akhumba ndalama, natembenuka kuchoka ku chikhulupiriro, nachibaya iwo okha ndi zisoni zambiri.
Koma iwe, munthu wa Mulungu, thawa izi. Tsata kulungama, uyeru wa Mulungu, chikhulupiriro, chikondi, kupirira, ndi ufatso.
Menya nkhondo yabwino ya chikhulupiriro. Mangirira moyo wosatha umene Mulungu anakuitanira, umene unaululira pamaso pa mboni zambiri.
Ndikulamula izi pamaso pa Mulungu wopatsawo moyo chilichonse, ndi pamaso pa Khristu Yesu amene anaululira umboni wabwino pamaso pa Pontio Pilato,
kuti usunga lamulo ili mopanda cholakwa ndi opanda chipwepwe mpaka kubwera kwa Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu,
ndipo pa nthawi yake Mulungu wadalitsika ndi wamphamvu mmodzi okha adzazionetsa, Mfumu ya mafumu ndi Ambuye wa maambuye,
amene ali ndi moyo wosatha yekha, amakhala m'kuwunika kosayandikika. Palibe munthu anamuona kapena angathe kumuona. Ulemu ndi mphamvu zikhale kwa iye nthawi yonse! Ameni.
Uza iwo achuma m'dziko lino kuti asadzikuze kapena kudalira chuma cha kusakhulupirirwa. M'malo mwake, akhulupirire Mulungu, amene amapatsa ife chilichonse chochuluka kuti tikondwere nacho.
Uza kuti agwire ntchito zabwino, akhale ochulukitsa ntchito zabwino, opeleka mwa ufulu, okonzeka nthawi yonse kugawana.
Mwanjira imeneyi adzasunga chuma chawo ngati maziko abwino a tsogolo, kuti agwire moyo weniweni.
Timoteo, sunga chimene Mulungu wakupatsira. Siya ziyankhulo zopanda Mulungu ndi zopusa za iwo akutsutsa ndi chidziwitso chao chonyenga.
Ena atembenuka kuchoka ku chikhulupiriro nasokonezeka. Chisomo cha Mulungu chikhale ndi inu nonse.
